title: Regular dyadic triangulations of delta-matroid polytopes
summary: Backman and Liu proved that every integral generalized permutohedron of type $A$, and in particular every matroid base polytope, admits a regular unimodular triangulation. The analogous statement fails in type $B$: the delta-matroid simplex \[\operatorname*{conv}\{\mathbf{0},\ e_1+e_2,\ e_1+e_3,\ e_2+e_3\}\] has normalized volume $2$ and no lattice points other than its vertices, so it has no unimodular triangulation.
